name: POST /api/leadflow/digests/run - generate what is due, once
description:
Generates every review due at the current America/Chicago local time (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC2), and escalates outputs past their due time in the same pass (3070e925-615d-429e-8209-1568671c3502#AC3).

ONE DIGEST PER RHYTHM PER BUSINESS DAY, enforced by a unique index rather than by the caller. The generator runs on a five-minute timer and two ticks inside the same window would otherwise produce two huddle packs with different numbers - worse than one late pack, because now nobody knows which one the meeting is working from. MEASURED LIVE: the second run generated zero.

WEEKENDS AND HOLIDAYS GENERATE NOTHING, BUT ESCALATION STILL RUNS. An 8:45 pack on a Sunday is noise, and noise is what teaches people to ignore the Monday one - but an output that came due on Friday afternoon was overdue all weekend, and holding its escalation until Monday loses the one signal that it slipped.

A REAL BUG WAS FOUND AND FIXED HERE by the live run: five of the nine rhythms are daily and internal, so a whole-day period collided them all on migration 015's existing (cadence, audience, period_start, period_end) index. The period now ends at the scheduled instant, which separates them and is the truer statement - the 11:30 sweep covers the day up to 11:30.

QA: measured live; five rhythms generated, second run zero, eight outputs escalated exactly once.

testCases.name: Every due review is generated, and a second run generates nothing
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
